model_output.rationale: CO-29 on both lines: filing limit expired. DOS 2025-01-19; 837P submitted 2025-10-15 (interchange date 251015); 277CA received 2025-01-27 — but that is a different submission. The 837P transmission date is 2025-10-15, nearly 9 months after DOS. Liberty Bell is commercial (CI). No payer-specific limit in artifacts, but 9 months exceeds even the most generous commercial floors (UHC 90d, Cigna 90d par). No statutory exception applies. MOA N211 confirms no appeal. CO = provider liability, not billable to patient.

root_cause.explanation: 837P submitted 2025-10-15 for DOS 2025-01-19 — ~9 months post-service. CO-29 on both lines. No clearinghouse acceptance inside the filing window; 277CA date 2025-01-27 references a prior submission not in evidence.

next_action.detail: Write off $138.62. CO-29 is provider liability; do not bill patient. MOA N211 bars appeal. No Medicare exception applies (commercial payer, CI). Confirm no prior accepted submission exists inside the payer's filing window before closing.

evidence.fact: Interchange date 251015 (2025-10-15); DOS 2025-01-19 — gap of ~9 months
CO-29 on lines 1 and 2, total $138.62 denied; MOA N211 (no appeal rights)
evidence.locator: CAS lines PA24642236L1, PA24642236L2; MOA segment

evidence.fact: 277CA acceptance dated 2025-01-27 — references TRC75364521, same as the October 837P submission date marker; received date 050 = 2025-01-27 conflicts with 837P interchange date of 2025-10-15, suggesting this ACK is for a prior unrelated submission
CO group code = provider liability, never billable to patient; CO-29 with no accepted prior submission inside the window → do_not_resubmit

citations.rule: Genuinely late, no exception → do_not_resubmit / write off; CO-29 not billable to patient
CO = provider contractual liability, never bill patient; CO-29 exhausted → do_not_resubmit
